politique_en: The Fund seeks to provide capital growth over the longer term. The Fund seeks to achieve its objective by holding shares or similar instruments relating to companies that are domiciled anywhere in the world which, in the view of the Investment Adviser, have the potential to be beneficiaries of evolving trends in international relations and their impact on the economic security of developed markets including, but not limited to, the beneficiaries and drivers of supply chain security, resource security and national security. There is no guarantee that objectives will be met.
